name: Keeper Bel'dugur
summary: In the Undercity's Apothecarium, Keeper Bel'dugur sends travelers to recover dark tomes and magical artifacts for his people. The scholarly Forsaken works among its researchers.

sections.title: A Collector of Dark Relics
sections.body: Keeper Bel'dugur works among the Apothecarium's vats and researchers. He sends travelers across Azeroth to recover dangerous arcane and occult relics. The Book of Ur, a legendary treatise on beings from other dimensions, lies locked inside Shadowfang Keep. It has drawn his keen interest. Many in the Undercity seek magical knowledge to cure undeath or wield it as a weapon. Bel'dugur's chosen acquisitions seem aimed at uncovering ancient, forbidden powers.

sections.title: Hidden Loyalties
sections.body: Keeper Bel'dugur's calm manner in the Undercity's Apothecarium hides his loyalty to the apocalyptic Twilight's Hammer cult. His assignments quietly advance the cult's esoteric aims. He seeks foundational grimoires of summoning and void magic beneath the unsuspecting eyes of the Royal Apothecary Society and Lady Sylvanas.

faq.q: Where can I find Keeper Bel'dugur?
faq.answer: Keeper Bel'dugur works in the Apothecarium, the alchemical district in the Undercity's southern lower ring.

faq.q: Why does Bel'dugur want The Book of Ur?
aliases: what does beldugur do with book of ur
faq.answer: The Book of Ur holds Dalaran mage Ur's foundational research on other dimensions and the feral worgen. Bel'dugur seeks its forbidden summoning principles for his true masters' dark schemes.

faq.q: Is Keeper Bel'dugur loyal to Lady Sylvanas?
faq.answer: Keeper Bel'dugur outwardly serves the Forsaken as an archivist and researcher. Hints in his investigations suggest his loyalties may lie elsewhere.

faq.q: What other tasks does he give adventurers?
faq.answer: Beyond the Book of Ur in Shadowfang Keep, Bel'dugur sends travelers after forgotten lore and forbidden tomes. These include dark treatises tied to ancient rituals and forbidden knowledge.

angles.text: As an Undead, you may see Bel'dugur as another scholarly Forsaken seeking forbidden knowledge to strengthen your kingdom. His true ambitions serve a cause beyond the Banshee Queen's fight for survival.
As a Warlock, you often cross paths with Bel'dugur's requests. His interests reach into dangerous grimoires, summoning beings from other dimensions, and dark occultism.
